ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for Electromagnetism: operator grammar, dimensional mapping, field behavior, and minimal coherence examples.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of electromagnetic fields within the RTT substrate.

electric_field.description: Describes force per unit charge; emerges from charge distribution and potential gradients.

magnetic_field.description: Describes field generated by moving charges or changing electric fields.

field_coupling.description: Electric and magnetic fields transform into each other under motion or time variation.

wave_propagation.description: Propagation of coupled E and B fields as a resonance pattern.

permittivity.description: Defines how electric fields propagate through a medium.

permeability.description: Defines how magnetic fields propagate through a medium.

boundary_conditions.description: Determine field behavior at interfaces and discontinuities.

dimensional_mapping.R1: Field behavior collapses to charge-interaction primitives; no coherent wave propagation.
dimensional_mapping.R2: Partial field behavior; projection effects distort coupling between E and B.
dimensional_mapping.R3: Full Maxwellian behavior; stable field coupling and wave propagation.

markers: stable coupling between electric and magnetic fields
field superposition without loss of coherence
instability_signals: loss of coupling between E and B

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats EM as a coherence-level field theory; substrate-level causes are resolved in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
